note: Advanced singing made musical: a fast run and an octave tune to open the range, then guide tones and improvising over a ii-V-I that the app plays, so the voice always hears the harmony it moves through. Every target is named with the chord it lands on.

exercise.title: Guide tones and a free line over ii-V-I
exercise.focus: Pentatonic run · octave tune · guide tones and chord-tone improvising over Dm7-G7-Cmaj7
exercise.why: Singing the 3rds and 7ths through a ii-V-I trains you to hear the chord changes.

sections.text: Start the mic. Sing the run at the tempo shown, keeping it light. Each pass moves up a semitone.
Press Play to hear a tune that leaps to the octave. Then start the mic to sing it. Watch where your top note lands on the staff.
Press Play. Sing the line in the notes view: {{f}} when Dm7 comes round, still {{f}} over G7, then {{e}} over Cmaj7. Second time round it is {{c}}, then {{b}}, then {{b}} again.
Press Play. Make up your own line over the same chords. Start each chord on one of its lit targets, its 3rd or its 7th. Leave space between phrases.
